description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the activated parameters ratio (expressed as a percentage on the x-axis, ranging from 100% to 25% in decreasing steps with a linear scale) and the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL, on the y-axis, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at 0.5 intervals). Four models are compared: “Transformer” (red dashed line, constant at approximately 11.7 across all ratios), “Only MoHD FFN” (gray square markers with solid line, starting at ~11.6 at 100%, dipping slightly to ~11.5 at 75%, then rising to ~11.8 at 25%), “Only MoHD ATTN” (dark blue circular markers with solid line, starting at ~11.6 at 100%, increasing steadily to ~14.1 at 25%), and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” (light blue star markers with solid line, starting at ~11.6 at 100%, rising to ~12.1 at 75%, then to ~13.1 at 25%). All lines show increasing perplexity as the activated parameters ratio decreases, with “Only MoHD ATTN” exhibiting the steepest rise and “Transformer” remaining flat.
